entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet in 'Electric Lime'. It looks like it was delivered eight days ago, on January 1st. Is that correct?
Okay. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?
The color is just... wrong. It doesn't look like the picture.
I understand. Sometimes screen settings can alter the appearance. That specific color is designed to be high-visibility to enhance rider safety on the trails, which is why it's so vibrant.
Whatever. The box is unopened. I just want to return it.
Not a problem at all. Since you're well within the 90-day return window for this helmet, I can process a full refund for you right away. I've just initiated the return in our system.

I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. You can simply print that, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any UPS store. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
Great. So I have to do all the work. Thanks.
I do apologize for the inconvenience of having to ship it back. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a nice day.
